title: Bound verification repair loops to a fixed number of attempts
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. After a failed verification he runs Agentic Recipe `verify_repair` with a stop contract of three repair attempts. One repair makes verification succeed — the loop does not run forever. Complements `fangore_verify_repair_recipe` for the recipe tile and `fangore_convergence_ceiling` for judge loops. [^insp-repair]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `verify_repair` via `VerifyRepairTemplate` / `verify_repair_runner` and product verb `run_recipe` (`VerifyRepairRecipeAdapter`). Library helper `bounded_repair` remains unit-covered for VER-03.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `verify_repair_succeeds.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; hard expects on final_status / repair_attempts.
